Hold one National Election on December 24, 2021.

Legal framework issued, Voter registration process was completed, candidates registration was done, electoral materials mobilized. however, elections didnt occur as planned. elections shifted to June/2022. waiting for agreement between HoR and SSC on a constitutional basis.
Support the HNEC to carry-on national election

The Project t continued to provide technical advice to HNEC in enhancing voter registration system and election results management system, outreach and advocacy, training and capacity building in the area of mitigating the impact of misinformation and hate speech on elections and facilitate building partnerships between HNEC and other EMBs in the region. Furthermore, the project provided technical support to formulation of Strategic Plan of Women Support Unit aiming at fostering women political participation. However, due to lack of agreement on constitutional basis for the elections between HoR and HSC, electoral calendar has not yet been agreed. UNSMIL is play a major role towards encouraging national main players to reach an agreement and move forward towards election.
Support the HNEC to carry-on national election
The UNDP supported the HNEC to organize national elections in Libya. Strong support was provided on voter registration, cards, IT System update. The elections planning is ongoing.
